captions.detailed: A classic naval carronade featuring a short, thick cast-iron barrel in dark gray, mounted on a wooden carriage. The carriage slides along a wide wooden deck rail platform, which is itself anchored on a circular pivot plate. The barrel can tilt vertically via revolute trunnion joints, the carriage slides linearly back and forth along the slide rail to simulate recoil, and the slide rail rotates horizontally on the deck pivot for traversing.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a naval carronade with a short, stubby cast-iron barrel. It should feature a sliding wooden carriage that recoils along a wooden slide rail, mounted on a pivoting deck base for horizontal traversing.
captions.factory: The model is built by defining individual parts with CadQuery geometries. The base deck is a thin rectangular box with a central cylinder representing the pivot. The slide rail is constructed using parallel box shapes with end stoppers. The carriage is modeled as a sliding block with side brackets, and the carronade barrel is modeled using a series of stepped cylinders and a sphere for the cascabel, joined with cylindrical trunnions. Articulations are defined using revolute joints for the deck pivot and barrel trunnions, and a prismatic joint for the carriage recoil.
